learning_outcomes.text: Design academic and professional insertion itineraries (itineraries)

syllabus_topics: First inputs on entrepreneurship and innovation
Creativity: Contextualization, idea generation and validation, definition of the project to develop
Financing and valuation of entrepreneurial projects
assessment_rules: The final grade for the course is based entirely on the Presentations/Expositions, which combines individual assessment (considering unjustified absences), peer assessment by group members, and assessment by a tribunal of three professors. In case a student does not pass the first call, they must orally and in writing present their entrepreneurial project proposal, clearly outlining the different parts worked on during the course for the resit.
